description: End one chat sign-in made by agent_resume: its chat key stops working and every chat holding it is signed out. The agent itself or its owner may call it. agent_status lists the agent's live chat keys in `chat_sessions` (key_id, label, created_at, last_used_at; never a secret). Idempotent. Requires: key_id.
name: agent_session_end
title: End one chat sign-in
